meta.parties: Dona Maria v. Don Paules De Silva

rules.statement: The surviving wife, upon the death of her husband, acquires a right to one-half of the property held in community during the marriage, but this is subject to the debts of the deceased. The administrator or executor can only administer and realize such estate as the deceased had testing powers over.
rules.supporting_quote: "On the death of either spouse the other has right to half of the property lately the subject of the marriage community. All that the heirs or legatees of the deceased have right to is the one-half to which the deceased was entitled."
